The review, the live mocks and the questions are on a page:
<https://claude.ai/artifact/AoTBNPiQ17jM6J6p9rSovw>. The user answered there on
2026-11-16; this file records the answers.

# 1. Style (the user's mix in the builder)

Tab strip on top (numbered, no rail); line icons with square ends; messages as bubbles;
panels as tiles with gaps, the focused one bordered in the accent; corners 4 px; three
header actions (call, video, share) and a menu; no top bar and no status line; compact
density.

- [x] A:

# 2. Font

The terminal font everywhere.

- [x] A:

# 3. Colour of people

One colour per person, as now.

- [x] A:

# 4. How to get there

Foundation first (a `ui` module, own SVG icons, `render.rs` split by view; nothing
looks different), then the restyle.

- [x] A:

# 5. First restyled release

The shell and the conversation first, the other views in the next one.

- [x] A:

# 6. Features after the restyle

Chosen: update notice with one-click update and stable / dev channels; replies,
reactions, edit and delete; a picture viewer inside Joma; an incoming-call overlay and
a floating call bar; settings as a full page; voice message transcription; GIFs.
Not chosen: command palette, search inside a conversation, group calls, remote control
and clipboard.

- [x] A:

# 7. TODO items 1 to 3

Paste and drop of pictures, the share picker with preview, zoom and resize of the
stage: they work, only the look needs the restyle. Ticked in `TODO.md`.

- [x] A:

# 8. Versioning

Start now: development versions `0.5.2.dev0`, `.dev1`, … until the user asks for a
stable release (Cargo spells them `0.5.2-dev.0`).

- [x] A:

# 9. App icon

Keep the pixel j.

- [x] A:

# Open after the answers

1. With no status line and no command palette, the keys need a place: proposal, `?`
   (or F1) opens an overlay with the keys of the current view.

   - [ ] A:
